about: L001 records idiopathic Parkinson’s disease. Motor symptoms make dressing difficult (L046). No levodopa or dopamine agonist was supplied in the last six months.

Possible finding: Azilect (rasagiline) is supplied without a qualifying local treatment. The missing facts are "Idiopathic Parkinson's disease", "Difficulty with daily activities caused by Parkinson's motor symptoms" and "Levodopa or a dopamine agonist supplied elsewhere for Parkinson's disease in the last six months".
The record has a line for Parkinson's disease and Sinemet (levodopa with carbidopa) is supplied every month, so there is no finding.
Motor symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease limit dressing. The neurologist and patient agreed to forgo both treatments after disabling hallucinations.
